title: Original BLR tester
statement: For each natural number $n$, define a sign tester whose seeds are pairs $(x,y)$ of points chosen independently and uniformly from the sign cube $\{-1,1\}^n$. Its check uses the three-query linearity predicate with parameter $1$, querying $x$, $y$, and their coordinatewise product scaled by $1$.
hypotheses_covered: A natural number n specifying the dimension of the sign cube
